summary: FutureFuel Corp. filed an 8-K to announce the date for its Q1 2026 earnings release (May 11, 2026, after market close). No special situation—no M&A, buyback, tender, restructuring, or activist campaign. This is a routine timing notice, not a special event. The filing includes no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisors, and no structural mechanics. No risk-arb angle exists.
